releaseNotes:
Bugfix release: the workbench status card now reports the telemetry actually stored on disk.

- The sidecar's per-process counters reset to zero on every restart, so the status card showed 0 spans / 0 metrics / 0 logs next to a data dir full of files and "Start receiver" looked like it had done nothing. Counts are now initialized from a recount of the persisted JSONL files.
- Retention purge recomputes the affected signal counters from disk (including files written by a previous run) instead of leaving stale totals, and closes only the purged day's writer instead of every open writer of that signal.
- Regression tests cover the restart recount, purge recount and the surviving current-day writer; the plugin was verified end-to-end against a real data directory (old build reported zeros, 0.2.1 reports the true persisted numbers) plus the smoke (21 checks) and end-to-end OTLP SDK suites (13 checks).
